body.message:
Hello!

My name is Maria, and I am currently based in Dubai. I would like to apply for a Holiday Homes Agent position, and I am also open to other roles related to sales, CRM, and operations support.

I have experience in real estate (including here in Dubai), client management, and operations, including handling high volumes of inquiries, coordinating bookings, and improving conversion rates.

I would be happy to share my CV and discuss potential opportunities.

Thank you!
